comment: NHL 24 1.60 franchise / custom-league settings, decoded from game-UPDATE\eboot.bin (vaddr = file - 0x51D80). 'confirmed' = read off the code; 'guess' = inferred from default values only. See docs\CAP_CONTRACTS_FINDINGS.md section 5.
flow: 1. New franchise: LeagueSettingsDefaults (vaddr 0x8351250, edi = league type 0..4, jump table 0x90C9DA0) fills a settings struct (rdx). The salary block comes from two rodata vector constants, vaddr 0x90761C0 (32 B) and 0x90761E0 (32 B); no league case overrides it.

2. The UI (Lua jobs nhl-job:franchise:custom-leagues:default-values-settings:get / nhl:franchise:custom-leagues:salary-values:overwrite) shows them as CustomMinSalaryCap, CustomMaxSalaryCap, CustomMinPlayerSalary, CustomMaxPlayerSalary, CustomMaxRookieSalary, CustomSalaryCap, CustomSalaryCapInflation, CustomPlayerSalaryScaling (Lua doubles).
3. The overwrite handler (vaddr 0x345F9C3..0x345F9E7) writes them into the runtime globals below.
4. While a league is loaded, vaddr 0x8252F95..0x825313F re-reads them from the league record ([0xBEBE360] + league*0x318) wherever that league's flag byte is set.
5. Static init (vaddr 0x880434D) sets floor/cap globals before any of this, and 11 inline pairs give min/max when the league pointer 0xBEBE0F0 is null.

settingIds.comment: Enum id -> name table built at vaddr 0x25F81C5 (stores into 0xB038630..). Ids of the salary settings, confirmed.

leagueRecord.comment: Per-league record at [0xBEBE360] + league*0x318 (198 int32). Flag bytes at [0xBEBE360] + league*0xC6 + 0x12B3.. say the value is set; master flag byte +0x173C.

fields.meaning: season year; getters fall back to 2023 (vaddr 0x81471F1, 0x835268F)

defaultsStruct.comment: Output of LeagueSettingsDefaults before the per-league switch (stock values). Only the salary block and team count are identified.

fields.meaning: cap inflation or salary scaling (0 = default)

save.comment: BeAGM DATA = JSON header + LZ4 frame whose content is a list of [1 byte + LZ4 frame] sections (9 in BeAGM0). Section 3 is the T3DB of 34 league* tables. No section holds the cap/floor/min/max as int32, double, $1K or $5K units, so the cap does not appear to be saved per franchise. The header has "SeasonYear": yyyymmdd. Section 0 starts with e7 07 09 00 (2023, month 9 = October).
save.status: decoded far enough to say the values are absent; sections 0/1/8 not mapped
